limitations: train only; two MX weight modes; this is not a paper reproduction
FP32 update master, FP32 gradients/Adam; A32; low from high codes by truncation
two forward/backwards: E2M3 hard CE, E2M1 detached soft CE, one Adam step
no same-protocol accuracy comparison with the older five-mode reference
official test used for checkpoint selection, not an independent test estimate
numerical weight-only MX emulation; no native MX kernel or energy claim
GPU bit-exact repeat/resume not guaranteed; fixed seed is not proof of determinism
100 train-only epochs; one seed; no guaranteed accuracy recovery or continual-learning result

config.purpose: one hundred complete train-only epochs: same shared-source truncation-aware pilot method
config.weight_preprocess: original W32 G(W); detached mean(abs(W)), tanh/max normalization
config.mx_group_axis: flatten Cin*Kh*Kw within each Cout, zero-pad tail
config.mx_scale_policy: high power-3 frexp rule on current G(W); same cached high codes/scales for both modes; low copies scales
config.mx_rounding: high nearest ties-to-even; low code shift2; finite FP32 source, scalar subnormal flush, local subnormals supported
config.ste_policy: identity wrt G(W) for high and complete high-to-low truncation path; retain original G(W) derivatives
config.numeric_kernel: FP32 F.conv2d; codec FP64 intermediates; not native low-bit kernels
config.source_cache: one detached high source per layer per paired minibatch; cleared before Adam
config.loss: E2M3 hard CE + E2M1 upstream soft CE with detached E2M3 teacher; T=1; no division by 2
config.batchnorm_policy: two active weight-mode banks; legacy keys32/4 do NOT imply A32/A4; banks1/2/8 unused
config.initialization_policy: fresh seed20261009; same untrained state as prior model construction; no warmstart
config.evaluation_policy: both modes on complete official test after every epoch; hard CE for both
config.selection_policy: first strict maximum of E2M3/A32 official-test top1
config.reporting_policy: both modes from same selected best checkpoint; also both at final epoch
config.rng_policy: global streams as upstream; sequential dropout draws per mode; saved at epoch boundaries
config.checkpoint_policy: immutable FP32 training state per epoch and selected best/last copies
config.export_policy: one high MX source with both BN banks per checkpoint; companion low derived from reloaded source; FP32 resume checkpoint separate

execution_settings.seed_source: explicit local seed, not reported by authors
execution_settings.precision_backend_policy: installed PyTorch defaults; no TF32 override

comparison_policy.production_replay: diagnostic only for floating-point numerical differences
comparison_policy.deterministic_replay: mandatory; original rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5, not widened
comparison_policy.scope: synthetic checks only; run/resume protocol not changed

synthetic_training_checks.manual_match_scope: deterministic synthetic replay; see per-tensor comparisons
